_about: The stat budget of the card game (locked build step 3; read by core/tcg/card_budget.gd, reported by tools/tcg_rules_check as information, never a failure: the starter decks are balanced by tools/tcg_sim). A creature of cost N may hold creature_per_cost x N + creature_base points of attack + health; a spell of cost N spell_per_cost x N + spell_base points of effect. Rarer cards get a little more (rarity). Keywords and effects spend points (keywords; effects per amount, or flat where marked). Targets multiply what an effect is worth (all_enemies hits more than one). Triggers that can happen again (turn_end ...) multiply it too. A card is off budget when what it holds differs from its budget by more than tolerance. Every number is a placeholder for the director.
